anchor_text: <Dialogue speaker="SPEAKER_04" time="01:09:27">So my wife and I have been loving your podcast. And we have a running joke in our catechism class that we have to mention your podcast at least once. And I just wanted to ask about the ending of [[Joshua]], because I read it. You said in your last podcast that the ending of [[Joshua]] says that all the land had been given to Israel. And I found it. And I just thought, man, what would? What would my dispensationalist friends who even served in Israel for decades? They've definitely read that. But how would they respond to that? Is there some promises in the later prophets that allude to that? Like, what is their hope still in if it has already been given to them?</Dialogue>
